title: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO Details
intro:
Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO is a book build issue of ₹93.66 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 65.96 lakh shares of ₹93.66 crore.

Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO opens for subscription on Nov 25, 2026 and closes on Nov 27, 2026. The allotment for the Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 30, 2026. Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Dec 2, 2026.

Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO is set issue price band at ₹130 to ₹142 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,84,000 (2,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,000 shares), amounting to ₹4,26,000.

ERUDORE CAPITAL Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MAS Services Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Basan Equity Broking Ltd.

Refer to Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in June 2022, Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Limited is an integrated agro-processing company engaged in the manufacturing of Jaggery Powder, Khandsari Sugar, jaggery-based value-added food products, and sugarcane by-products. The company also operates a Cane Seed nursery, enabling backward integration in sugarcane cultivation. It serves both B2B customers through jaggery powder, Khandsari sugar, and by-products, and B2C customers through its "Feel Guddy" branded jaggery-based premix products, including Jaggery Tea, Jaggery Coffee, Instant Rice Kheer, Jaggery Laddoo, and Jaggery Lapsi.

The company follows an integrated sugarcane processing model, utilizing sugarcane to manufacture primary products while efficiently monetizing by-products such as bagasse, molasses, press mud, and ash. With backward integration into sugarcane seed cultivation, captive processing facilities, and a focus on sustainable and zero-waste manufacturing, the company has established a diversified product portfolio catering to both industrial and retail markets.
Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries emphasizes operational efficiency, quality control, sustainable manufacturing practices, and product innovation.
As of March 31, 2026, the company employed 155 permanent personnel across production, engineering, agriculture, administration, sales, finance, security, and other operational functions.

faqs.question: How to apply in Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .
